checks.name: Outbox publication recovery
checks.observed: Durable intent recovered; duplicate enqueue kept one job and one report.
checks.expected: Failure injection recovers without duplicate persisted results.

checks.name: Worker termination and restart
checks.observed: OS-killed a RUNNING worker; restart recovered the stalled job, one result, INTERRUPTED attempt retained.
checks.expected: Failure injection recovers without duplicate persisted results.

checks.name: Crash after result commit
checks.observed: Process exited after PostgreSQL commit, before queue acknowledgement; restart retained one report and one completion audit.
checks.expected: Failure injection recovers without duplicate persisted results.

checks.name: Bounded failure and controlled replay
checks.observed: Three failed attempts with backoff; observer denied; manager replay audited once; generation 1 produced one report.
checks.expected: Failure injection recovers without duplicate persisted results.

checks.name: Missing queue record reconciliation
checks.observed: Removed a published queue record; reconciliation republished durable intent and produced one report.
checks.expected: Failure injection recovers without duplicate persisted results.

checks.expected: Static export compiles and type checks

checks.name: Cloudflare local runtime

checks.name: Docker Compose execution
checks.expected: Build images, bootstrap a clean database and complete the browser workflow with a running report worker.

checks.name: Public Cloudflare deployment
checks.expected: Free managed database, restricted role, deployed URL, runtime CPU and browser smoke checks.
checks.observed: Deployment has not been verified. A dry-run build is not a public deployment.

checks.name: Restricted database credentials
checks.expected: Application authenticates separately and PostgreSQL denies audit mutation and schema administration.
checks.observed: Runtime authenticates as a distinct restricted desk_app role; Runtime has no inherited roles or owned application tables; Application CRUD and bounded cleanup available; schema creation denied; Atomic command function runs with caller privileges, without owner elevation; Audit mutation, workspace expiry manipulation and migration metadata access denied by PostgreSQL
